rules.guidance: Avoid `async void` except for event handlers — exceptions can't be caught and crash the process. Return `Task`.
Don't block on async with `.Result` / `.Wait()` / `.GetAwaiter().GetResult()` — it risks deadlocks. `await` instead.
Dispose `IDisposable`/`IAsyncDisposable` instances (e.g. with `using`); a leaked handle/connection is a resource bug.
Library/non-UI code should `ConfigureAwait(false)` to avoid capturing a sync context.
Don't swallow exceptions with empty `catch {}` or `catch (Exception)` that ignores; log or rethrow with context.
Building strings in a loop with `+=` is O(n^2); use `StringBuilder`.
Read-only EF Core queries should use `AsNoTracking()` to avoid change-tracking overhead.
Honor nullable reference types: don't dereference a possibly-null value without a check; avoid `!` (null-forgiving) unless justified.
